nodes.title: HTML5
nodes.description: Semantic tags, document structure, forms, tables, media embedding, accessibility basics (alt text, labels, ARIA roles), meta tags, SEO basics, favicon, viewport.

nodes.title: CSS3
nodes.description: Box model, selectors, specificity, pseudo-classes/elements, Flexbox and CSS Grid, responsive design, animations, transitions, transforms, CSS variables, positioning, z-index stacking.

nodes.title: JavaScript (Core)
nodes.description: Variables, data types, control flow, functions, scope, closures, hoisting, arrays and array methods, DOM manipulation, event handling, asynchronous JS, ES6+ features.

nodes.title: Git & GitHub
nodes.description: init, add, commit, push, pull, branch, merge, resolving merge conflicts, .gitignore, README writing, pull requests, forking, collaborating on a shared repo.

nodes.title: Dev Tools & Fundamentals
nodes.description: VS Code setup, Browser DevTools, how the web works (DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, client-server model, status codes), npm/npx basics, package.json, semantic versioning.

nodes.title: CSS Frameworks
nodes.description: Bootstrap 5 grid system and components, Tailwind CSS utility-first workflow, and when to use a framework vs writing custom CSS.

nodes.title: React.js Fundamentals
nodes.description: JSX, functional components, props, composition, useState, useEffect, conditional and list rendering, keys, forms and controlled components, component lifecycle.

nodes.title: React — Intermediate
nodes.description: React Router, custom hooks, useRef/useMemo/useCallback, Context API for global state, prop drilling, calling REST APIs with fetch/Axios with loading and error states.

nodes.title: React — Advanced
nodes.description: State management with Redux Toolkit or Zustand, protected routes and JWT-based auth flow, code-splitting/lazy loading/memoization, and Next.js basics.

nodes.title: Node.js
nodes.description: Node runtime, CommonJS vs ES modules, npm ecosystem, file system module, event loop, environment variables (.env), process management.

nodes.title: Express.js
nodes.description: Routing, middleware, request/response cycle, route params, query params, body parsing, error-handling middleware, CORS, and a clean REST API folder structure (MVC).

nodes.title: MongoDB & Mongoose
nodes.description: NoSQL concepts, documents vs collections, MongoDB Atlas setup, Mongoose schemas/models/validation, CRUD operations, querying, population, indexing basics, aggregation pipeline.

nodes.title: Authentication & Security
nodes.description: Password hashing with bcrypt, JWT-based authentication with access and refresh tokens, protected routes with auth middleware, and basic security (input validation, rate limiting, helmet.js).

nodes.title: Connecting Frontend + Backend
nodes.description: Axios instance setup, interceptors for auth tokens, loading/error states, file/image uploads (Multer, Cloudinary/S3), and real-time features with Socket.io.

nodes.title: Deployment
nodes.description: Frontend on Vercel or Netlify, backend on Render/Railway/VPS, MongoDB Atlas, production environment variables and CORS, custom domains.

nodes.title: MERN Portfolio Projects (pick 2–3 to actually finish)
nodes.description: Full stack blog/CMS with auth and image uploads, e-commerce app with cart and checkout, real-time chat app with Socket.io, or a social media clone.

nodes.title: Java Basics
nodes.description: Variables, data types, operators, control flow, arrays, methods, overloading, static vs instance members, input/output, exception handling.

nodes.title: Object-Oriented Programming
nodes.description: Classes, objects, constructors, this keyword, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction, encapsulation, interfaces vs abstract classes, access modifiers, packages.

nodes.title: Collections & Generics
nodes.description: List, Set, Map implementations, Iterator, Comparator vs Comparable, generics basics, and Java 8+ features (Lambdas, Streams API, Optional, method references).

nodes.title: Multithreading & Exception Handling
nodes.description: Thread creation, synchronization basics, checked vs unchecked exceptions, try-with-resources, and basic concurrency utilities (ExecutorService).

nodes.title: Build Tools & JVM Basics
nodes.description: Maven (pom.xml, dependencies, build lifecycle) with Gradle as alternative, plus JDK vs JRE vs JVM and how Java compiles and runs.

nodes.title: Web Fundamentals (Java side)
nodes.description: JDBC for connecting Java to MySQL directly, Servlets & JSP basics conceptually, and the MVC architecture pattern.

nodes.title: Spring Framework Core
nodes.description: Inversion of Control and Dependency Injection, Spring Beans, ApplicationContext, annotations (@Component, @Autowired, @Bean), and Spring MVC basics.

nodes.title: Spring Boot
nodes.description: Auto-configuration, starters, embedded Tomcat, application.properties/yml, building REST APIs, exception handling, validation, DTOs vs Entities, and layered Controller → Service → Repository architecture.

nodes.title: Spring Data JPA & Hibernate
nodes.description: Entity mapping, relationships, JpaRepository, query methods, @Query (JPQL/native), pagination and sorting, connecting to MySQL, database migrations basics.

nodes.title: Spring Security & JWT
nodes.description: Authentication vs authorization, SecurityFilterChain, BCrypt password encoding, custom UserDetailsService, JWT generation/validation/filters, role-based access control, OAuth2 login.

nodes.title: Connecting Spring Boot + React
nodes.description: CORS configuration in Spring Boot, Axios calls from React to Spring Boot REST endpoints, storing JWT on the frontend via Axios interceptors, and file uploads with multipart/form-data.

nodes.title: Testing
nodes.description: JUnit 5 + Mockito basics for service-layer unit tests, and testing REST endpoints with MockMvc or Postman/Newman.

nodes.title: Microservices & Cloud-Native
nodes.description: Monolith vs microservices trade-offs, Spring Cloud service discovery (Eureka) and API Gateway, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), Docker containerization, and conceptual Kubernetes.

nodes.title: Deployment
nodes.description: Backend on Railway, Render, or AWS EC2/Elastic Beanstalk; frontend on Vercel/Netlify; database on Railway MySQL / AWS RDS / PlanetScale.

nodes.title: DSA
nodes.description: Arrays, strings, recursion, backtracking, trees, graphs, dynamic programming, greedy, and time/space complexity analysis — run in parallel throughout, not just Phase 8.

nodes.title: Low-Level Design (LLD)
nodes.description: SOLID principles, design patterns (Factory, Singleton, Strategy, Observer, Builder), UML basics, and classic LLD problems like Parking Lot, Elevator System, Splitwise, Tic-Tac-Toe, BookMyShow.

nodes.title: High-Level Design (HLD)
nodes.description: Scalability, caching (Redis), CDNs, database sharding and replication, CAP theorem, SQL vs NoSQL trade-offs, message queues, and classic HLD problems.
